Here are a few ready-to-copy prompts you can use (pick one and adjust details like magazine name, colors, and audience). I’ll keep them illustration-focused and suitable for a donation/appeal page.

### Option 1 — Warm, editorial magazine illustration (generic, versatile)
**Prompt:**  
“Editorial illustration for a magazine donation appeal: a diverse group of readers and creators gently passing a single glowing magazine from hand to hand, symbolizing community support and sustaining independent journalism. Warm, hopeful mood, soft textured shading, clean linework, modern flat + watercolor hybrid style, subtle paper grain, balanced composition with generous negative space at top for headline text, muted yet uplifting color palette (teal, coral, cream), no visible currency, no logos, no readable text, high-resolution.”

### Option 2 — “Keep independent journalism alive” metaphor (strong concept)
**Prompt:**  
“Conceptual editorial illustration: a magazine formed like a small lighthouse on a calm sea, its pages emitting a warm beam of light, with small boats (representing readers) guiding toward it. Mood: optimistic, supportive, trustworthy. Contemporary magazine illustration style, minimal realism, textured brushwork, limited color palette (navy, cream, warm yellow), ample negative space for copy, no words, no branding, print-ready.”

### Option 3 — Community support / sustainability theme (nature metaphor)
**Prompt:**  
“Editorial illustration for a financial support appeal: hands of different ages and skin tones watering a young plant growing from an open magazine, symbolizing sustaining stories and independent publishing. Soft natural light, friendly contemporary illustration, slight grain, muted greens and warm neutrals, clean shapes, centered composition with room for text, no money imagery, no readable text, high detail, print quality.”

### Option 4 — More direct “reader-supported” message without money visuals
**Prompt:**  
“Modern editorial illustration: a cozy reading corner with an armchair and side table; a magazine on the table is surrounded by small floating icons representing support (hearts, stars, speech bubbles) forming a subtle halo. Inviting, premium magazine aesthetic, minimalist yet warm, soft shadows, textured background, negative space for headline and QR code, no text, no logos, high-resolution.”

---

### Useful add-ons (optional)
- **Aspect ratio:** “portrait 4:5” (good for a full-page magazine), or “A4 portrait” if supported  
- **Print readiness:** “CMYK-safe colors, 300 dpi, clean edges”  
- **Avoid:** “no photorealism, no AI artifacts, no extra fingers, no text, no watermarks”

If you tell me the magazine’s vibe (serious journalism vs arts/culture), target audience, and whether it’s a full-page print ad or web banner, I can tailor a single best prompt to your exact layout and tone.
